name: What is a pergola and what are its benefits?

mainEntity.name: What is a pergola and what are its benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pergola is an outdoor garden feature forming a shaded walkway, passageway, or sitting area of vertical posts or pillars that usually support cross-beams and a sturdy open lattice. They are commonly used to define outdoor living spaces, provide partial shade, and enhance the aesthetic appeal of a home. Benefits include creating an inviting outdoor entertainment area, increasing property value, and offering a framework for climbing plants to grow, adding natural beauty and additional shade.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pergola is an outdoor structure with posts supporting an open lattice, providing partial shade and defining outdoor living spaces. Benefits include enhancing aesthetics, increasing property value, and supporting climbing plants.
